description_en: Removes tags from specified Elastic Block Storage (EBS) resources
description_zh: 为指定的EBS资源统一解绑标签
kebab_example: aliyun ebs untag-resources --resource-id pair-cn-c4d2t7f0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type diskreplicapair --region cn-hangzhou
name: UntagResources

parameters.help_en: The ID list of the resource. You can specify up to 50 resource IDs in each call
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The list of tag keys. You can specify up to 20 tag keys in the list
parameters.help_zh: 标签键。最多包含20个子项
parameters.name: tag_key

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to remove all tags from the resource. This parameter is valid only when the TagKey.N parameter is not specified. Valid values:

true: removes all tags from the resource.
false: does not remove all tags from the resource.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否解绑资源上全部的标签。当请求中未设置TagKey.N时，该参数才有效。取值范围：
true。
false。

默认值：false
parameters.name: all

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the resource. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 资源所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the resource. Valid values:

dedicatedblockstoragecluster: dedicated block storage cluster
diskreplicapair: the replication pair.
diskreplicagroup: replication pair-consistent group
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型定义。取值范围：

dedicatedblockstoragecluster：专属块存储集群。
diskreplicapair：异步复制关系。
diskreplicagroup：一致性复制组
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that it is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. The request ID is returned regardless of whether the call is successful
RequestId.title_en: 请求 ID。无论调用接口成功与否，我们都会返回请求 ID。
RequestId.title_zh: 请求 ID。无论调用接口成功与否，我们都会返回请求 ID。
